recent_articles.title: Carney says Alberta is 'essential' to Canada as province plans vote on separation
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Mark Carney** stated that **Alberta** is an "essential" part of Canada, while **Alberta Premier Danielle Smith** announced a referendum on October 19th to determine whether the province should remain in Canada or pursue independence. The vote comes after pressure from a growing separatist movement and a recent legal challenge by First Nations groups halted the process of verifying petition signatures.  Smith maintains that Albertans deserve a say in their future, despite criticism from various organizations, including the Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation and the New Democratic Party.

recent_articles.title: PTI workers stage protests in various cities, defy Section 144 in Islamabad - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **PTI** and **TTAP** organized protests across Pakistan on Friday, demanding the release of former prime minister Imran Khan and addressing concerns over inflation, rising petroleum prices, and deteriorating law and order.  **PTI Islamabad President Aamir Mughal**, along with other leaders, held a protest in Islamabad despite Section 144 being in place, while **Shandana Gulzar** from **TTAP** spoke at a press conference in Peshawar, highlighting the plight of civilians in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and accusing the federal government of mismanagement. These protests were joined by political and social activists across the country, including those from the Haqooq-i-Khalq Party.

recent_articles.title: Tulsi Gabbard resigns as US director of national intelligence
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tulsi Gabbard**, the US director of national intelligence under **President Donald Trump**, will resign from her position on June 30th.  She cited her husband's recent bone cancer diagnosis as the reason for her departure, stating she cannot continue in her role while he faces this challenge. **Trump** expressed his support for Gabbard and noted her "incredible job" during her tenure.  **Aaron Lukas**, the principal deputy director, will assume the acting director position.

recent_articles.title: Canada’s Carney says Alberta is ‘essential’ as province mulls separation | Politics News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney** emphasized the importance of **Alberta** to Canada's economy, stating that he is working with the province to improve it.  **Premier Danielle Smith** announced a referendum on whether Alberta should remain part of Canada or hold a vote for separation. The decision came after a court blocked a petition to hold a vote on separation, citing lack of consultation with Indigenous groups. **Smith** stated she opposes separation but believes in respecting the democratic rights of Albertans and that she will respect the results of the referendum.  Conservative Party Leader **Pierre Poilievre** said he would campaign against separation, while some Liberals criticized **Smith** for stoking separatist sentiment for political gains.

recent_articles.title: Canadian prime minister says Alberta ‘essential’ to country as separatists push for independence | Canada | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mark Carney**, the Canadian prime minister, emphasized that **Alberta** is crucial to Canada's future.  Following a judge's ruling halting an independence referendum petition, **Danielle Smith**, Alberta's premier, vowed to hold a vote on whether to initiate the legal process for a binding referendum in October. **Smith** maintains she supports Alberta remaining within Canada but believes a public debate is necessary.  **Carney** expressed support for Canada and its future while acknowledging that Alberta plays a vital role.

recent_articles.title: Turkish opposition fights court ousting of leaders in ruling boosting Erdogan
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Turkish** opposition, led by Özgür Özel of the Republican People's Party (CHP), is challenging a court ruling removing them from leadership positions. The appeals court declared the 2023 leadership election null and void, prompting protests and criticism from opposition leaders who accuse President **Recep Tayyip Erdogan** of seeking to eliminate rivals.  The ruling has sparked concerns about the future of Turkey's political landscape and potential for snap elections.

recent_articles.title: Tony Abbott to become new Liberal party president in former PM’s return to political frontlines | Tony Abbott | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tony Abbott**, the former Australian prime minister, will become the new president of the **Liberal party**.  He was unanimously elected after his sole opponent, former foreign minister **Alexander Downer**, chose to run for vice-president. The election will be confirmed at the Liberal party's federal council meeting next weekend. Abbott will succeed **John Olsen** and return to active politics after losing his seat in 2019.  Moderate Liberals are concerned about Abbott's potential influence on party direction, particularly regarding immigration. Meanwhile, the Victorian Liberal party state council is holding a meeting where former federal director **Brian Loughnane**, who is married to Peta Credlin, is expected to be elected as president.

recent_articles.title: After CM Vijay’s order to revive Amma Canteens, AIADMK hopes for comeback of other legacy schemes - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **AIADMK** functionaries have called for the revival and strengthening of several welfare schemes implemented during the party's previous tenures, including Amma Canteens, Amma Salt, Cradle Baby scheme, Amma Scooters, and 'Gold for Thali'. They also criticized the **Tamil Nadu** government's handling of government properties and alleged that several welfare programs initiated by the previous AIADMK regime have been discontinued or poorly implemented.  These criticisms were made during a meeting with the newly elected government led by **C. Joseph Vijay**.

recent_articles.title: Turkish court ousts leader of main opposition party | Politics News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A Turkish court overturned the 2023 leadership election of the main opposition **Republican People’s Party (CHP)**, reinstating former chair Kemal Kilicdaroglu as interim leader. The ruling is seen as a move against the CHP, which won a significant victory over President **Recep Tayyip Erdogan**'s AK Party in the 2024 local elections and has been rising in polls. The CHP rejected the decision as an "attempted coup," while the government claimed it renewed faith in the rule of law.  The ruling sparked market turmoil, with the Borsa Istanbul index dropping 6 percent and government bonds sliding.

recent_articles.title: Congress leader Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan elected Kerala Speaker - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan**, a senior Congress leader, was elected as the Speaker of the 16th Kerala Legislative Assembly on Friday (May 22, 2026). He won with 101 votes, defeating **A.C. Moideen** and **B.B. Gopakumar**.  The election took place after **G. Sudhakaran**, the previous Pro Tem Speaker, chose not to vote.  **V.D. Satheesan**, the Chief Minister, and **Pinarayi Vijayan**, the Leader of the Opposition, led Radhakrishnan to the Speaker's chair.

recent_articles.title: DMK faces a challenge as allies set to join TVK government - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DMK**, the Secular Progressive Alliance's leader since 2017, has lost most of its pre-poll allies.  The party is now left with only **MDMK** and **Manithaneya Makkal Katchi**, who contested on its Rising Sun symbol. Additionally, the DMDK remains loyal to the TVK government. The Congress abandoned the DMK after the Assembly polls and joined Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay's Cabinet on Thursday, while the IUML and VCK are expected to join the Ministry on Friday.

recent_articles.title: Voter confusion fears over simultaneous polls ‘misplaced’, says ONOE JPC chairman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.P. Chaudhary**, chairman of the Joint Parliamentary Committee on ‘One Nation One Election’, defended the proposal, arguing that Indian voters are politically astute and can differentiate between national and state issues.  He cited examples from Delhi and other states where voters supported different parties in Lok Sabha and Assembly elections. **CII**, **ASSOCHAM**, and **GCCI** backed the proposal, while **Gujarat University Vice-Chancellor Dr. Neerja Gupta** highlighted how frequent polls disrupt academic schedules and increase financial costs. The committee also heard concerns from the **Congress**, which argued that simultaneous elections would allow national narratives to overshadow state issues.

recent_articles.title: House Republicans cancel vote on war powers resolution to end US war in Iran | House of Representatives | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **House Republicans** canceled a scheduled vote on a war powers resolution aimed at ending the US war with Iran, avoiding potential political embarrassment for **Donald Trump**.  The cancellation prompted criticism from **Hakeem Jeffries**, **Katherine Clark**, and **Pete Aguilar**, who called it cowardly. The Democrats argued that the Republican-controlled House is acting as a "wholly-owned subsidiary" of the Trump administration. Despite the postponement until June, the resolution is expected to pass with bipartisan support.

recent_articles.title: Trump is supporting Spencer Pratt in the LA mayor’s race. It may be a poison pill | Los Angeles | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump**'s recent endorsement of **Spencer Pratt**, a former Republican and reality TV star, is expected to benefit Democrats in the Los Angeles mayoral race.  Pratt has gained traction by capitalizing on anger over the city's response to the wildfires and homelessness crisis. While Pratt claims his focus will be solely on local issues, his opponents have seized on **Trump's** support as a sign of potential conservative leanings.

recent_articles.title: US Senate pushes back against Trump’s $1.8bn ‘anti-weaponisation’ fund | Donald Trump News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Senate Republicans** delayed a vote on immigration enforcement funding, citing concerns about **President Donald Trump’s** “anti-weaponisation” fund and his request for $1 billion in funds to build a White House ballroom.  The delay comes after **Trump** sued the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) for leaking his tax refunds, prompting criticism of potential conflicts of interest.  **Senator Don Bacon** stated that Trump has lost support within the Senate due to these actions, and **Senator Thom Tillis** called the “anti-weaponisation” fund "stupid on stilts." The Senate will return from its recess in June.

recent_articles.title: Historic shift: Vijay’s Cabinet marks Tamil Nadu’s best SC representation till date - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, has appointed seven members from the Scheduled Caste (SC) community to his Cabinet. This marks a significant increase in SC representation compared to previous Cabinets.  Political analyst Stalin Rajangam believes this is a positive step towards inclusivity and sets a benchmark for future governments. However, Punitha Pandiyan, former Vice President of the Tamil Nadu SC/ST Commission, argues that celebrating this development trivializes SC politics.

recent_articles.title: 22 Ministers aged below 50: Cabinet signals generational shift in Tamil Nadu politics - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Tamil Nadu government's Cabinet has seen a significant shift in age composition, with the 2026 TVK Cabinet featuring the youngest average age among the three governments examined.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of this government, is 51 years old and his cabinet features the youngest Ministers at just 28 and 29 years old. The 2026 TVK Cabinet has nine Ministers in their 30s, followed by a senior tier of seven Ministers in their 50s, three in their 60s, and only one in the 70-80 age bracket.  This contrasts with the 2021 DMK Cabinet which was heavily dominated by older leaders.

recent_articles.title: Congress workers clash with police in Jaipur during stir against NEET-UG paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** party workers clashed with **police** in **Rajasthan** on Thursday during a protest against the NEET-UG exam paper leak.  Led by **State Congress president Govind Singh Dotasra**, the protesters demanded the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and the dissolution of the **National Testing Agency**. The demonstrators, carrying banners and placards, were forcibly dispersed using water cannons. Some protesters suffered minor injuries.

recent_articles.title: BJP functionary’s request to HR&CE Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vinoj Selvam**, a BJP functionary, urged newly appointed **Ramesh**, the Minister for Hindu Religious & Charitable Endowments, to only worship at the Srirangam temple if he visits.  Selvam's statement followed social media posts showing **Ramesh** with images of late social reformer 'Periyar' E.V. Ramasamy.

recent_articles.title: Ladakh seeks belonging through representation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union Ministry of Home Affairs** argues that Ladakh needs more districts rather than a legislature due to its sparse population, strategic sensitivity, and financial dependence on the Centre. This argument is criticized as flawed and reflects an impoverished understanding of democracy, echoing historical paternalistic views by the British Empire.

recent_articles.title: Ladakh leaders to meet Home Ministry officials on May 22, Sonam Wangchuk part of delegation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A delegation from Ladakh, including climate activist **Sonam Wangchuk**, is meeting with **Union Home Ministry** officials on Friday to discuss demands for constitutional safeguards such as Statehood and inclusion under the Sixth Schedule of the Constitution. This meeting follows a previous inconclusive high-powered committee meeting in February and comes after the violence in Leh city in September 2025, which stalled talks.  The delegation will reiterate their demands for Statehood, while officials have offered safeguards under Article 371 of the Constitution.

recent_articles.title: Imran’s cases will be fixed after Eid, CJP assures PTI - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Justice of Pakistan (CJP) Yahya Afridi** assured **PTI General Secretary Salman Akram Raja** that the cases concerning access to a personal physician, family members and counsel for former premier Imran Khan would be scheduled after Eidul Azha.  Raja reported that the CJP had issued instructions to senior officers of the Supreme Court to fix these petitions. The PTI general secretary also stated that the appeals regarding Imran's access were pending before the SC since October 2025, and a petition by Imran's sister challenging the IHC ruling was also pending.  The **Supreme Court** disposed of appeals filed by the Punjab prosecution seeking cancellation of bail granted to **Ejaz Ahmed Chaudhry**, involved in the May 9 cases.

recent_articles.title: Take forward reforms, PM tells Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** convened a full Council of Ministers meeting in New Delhi on Thursday, May 21, 2026. The session focused on the government's reform agenda amidst geopolitical shifts and saw presentations from various ministries including labor, power, commerce, finance, agriculture, railways, and NITI Aayog.  The meetings reviewed past achievements and future plans, outlining targets for each ministry.

recent_articles.title: David Lammy chairs first meeting of board set up to improve diversity among judiciary | Judiciary | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **David Lammy**, the first black lord chancellor, and **Sue Carr**, the lady chief justice, have formed a new judicial and legal diversity board to address underrepresentation of minority ethnic and working-class solicitors in the judiciary. The board aims to fast-track solicitor recruitment from underrepresented backgrounds and improve mentoring schemes for new recruits.  The initiative follows criticism that Lammy's plans to reduce jury trials could exacerbate racial and class bias within the judiciary, a concern echoed by legal professionals like **Keir Monteith KC** who believe institutional racism hinders progress. The board hopes to work with existing organizations like the UK Association of Black Judges to address these issues.

recent_articles.title: Himachal urban poll results reflect public confidence in Congress; party united with no groupism, says CM Sukhu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu**, Chief Minister of **Himachal Pradesh**, attributed the Congress-backed candidates' victory in recent urban local body elections to public approval of the party's governance. He highlighted the sustained popularity despite anti-incumbency pressures and emphasized a unified effort among party workers.  He also criticized the BJP for its perceived lack of support for Himachal Pradesh, particularly regarding issues like the Revenue Deficit Grant and natural disasters. Sukhu asserted that the Congress has fulfilled its promises and exceeded expectations in delivering on commitments such as welfare schemes and reforms in education and healthcare.

recent_articles.title: Sedition trials can go on if accused is willing: Supreme Court - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** has lifted a four-year hold on sedition trials, allowing courts to proceed with cases where the accused do not object. The court clarified that if an accused consents to continued proceedings under Section 124A of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), courts can decide matters on merits. This decision follows an interim order in 2022, during which the court had requested the government to reconsider the colonial-era provision.  The **Supreme Court** directed the Madhya Pradesh High Court to hear the petitioner's appeal and related cases.

recent_articles.title: Parody Cockroach Janta political party’s rise reflects youth anger in India | India | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A satirical online movement, the Cockroach Janta (People's) party, has gained significant traction in India.  **Abhijeet Dipke**, a political communications strategist and student at Boston University, founded the movement after **Surya Kant**, the Supreme Court chief justice, sparked backlash with comments comparing unemployed young people to cockroaches. The CJP uses absurdist humor to mock corruption, joblessness, and government dysfunction, attracting millions of followers on social media.  While some dismiss it as a digital gimmick, Dipke believes it reflects mounting frustration among India's youth and could lead to real political change.

recent_articles.title: From rallies to reels: political catchphrases turn dance anthems in Kolkata - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A new genre of political techno remixes has emerged in Kolkata, using catchy hooks and meme-friendly punchlines to criticize politicians. The trend began with songs like "Khela Hobe" and continues with remixed versions of "Hamba Hamba", "Mach Chor", and "File Chor". These songs often target specific individuals or parties, gaining popularity through social media platforms like Instagram and YouTube Shorts.  The use of crude humor and satirical lyrics reflects a culture of insult-flinging on social media while also expressing anger towards political leaders who abuse power.

recent_articles.title: India's 'Cockroach Janta Party' goes viral, spotlights Gen Z worries - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A five-day-old group called the **Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)** has gained significant traction in India, surpassing the Instagram followers of the ruling **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.  The CJP, founded by 30-year-old Abhijeet Dipke, addresses issues like unemployment, inflation, and political representation, resonating with a large segment of young Indians who feel ignored by mainstream politics. The group's rapid growth reflects the anxieties felt by India's youth, as highlighted in a recent Deloitte Global survey that found Gen Z facing financial stress and postponing major life decisions due to economic concerns. Dipke emphasizes the CJP's commitment to democratic and peaceful means of political engagement, while also acknowledging its potential for significant change within Indian politics.

recent_articles.title: Five key takeaways from Democrats’ autopsy report on Kamala Harris’s loss | Kamala Harris News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Democratic National Committee (DNC)** released its long-awaited autopsy report on why former Vice President Kamala Harris lost the 2024 presidential election. The report, riddled with factual errors and missing sections, failed to address key issues like the Biden administration's support for Israel during the Gaza war, which some analysts believe contributed to Harris's loss.  The report also criticized the White House for assigning Harris immigration responsibilities without adequate preparation and suggested that the campaign focused too heavily on defeating Trump instead of promoting Harris's own vision. The report was released in its unedited format despite acknowledging its shortcomings and did not include specific recommendations for future elections.

recent_articles.title: Hungary to limit PMs to eight years in office, warding off any Orbán comeback | Hungary | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Péter Magyar**, leader of the **Tisza** party, submitted a constitutional amendment to limit prime ministers to eight years in office. The draft amendment would bar **Viktor Orbán**, who has served five terms as prime minister since 1998, from returning to the role.  The amendment also aims to dissolve the controversial sovereignty protection office and reclaim control of foundations that were previously controlled by loyalists of the previous government. This move is part of a broader effort by the new government to dismantle the constitution unilaterally rewritten and amended by **Orbán**'s Fidesz party and restore democratic checks and balances. The amendment, expected to pass with the support of the **Tisza** party’s supermajority in parliament, will be discussed next week.

recent_articles.title: Room for reconciliation within the AIADMK - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)** and the rebel camp of the **All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK)** are attempting to reconcile after a recent trust vote where the rebels supported the government while the TVK regime voted against them.  A senior rebel leader claims efforts have been made to bring the two camps together, with mediators involved and petitions filed for disqualification proceedings. The rebel camp insists on an early general council meeting to address electoral setbacks and decision-making processes within the organization, despite not being invited to the swearing-in ceremony of the TVK regime.

recent_articles.title: Seems PTI will now have to 'resort to agitation', says MNA after party leaders yet again denied meeting with Imran - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ahad Ali Shah**, a member of the **Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI)**, stated that his party would resort to agitation after being denied another meeting with former prime minister **Imran Khan**.  The Islamabad High Court has granted **Khan** twice-weekly meetings at Adiala jail, but restrictions have prevented him from meeting visitors for several weeks. The PTI submitted a list of six leaders, including Shah, for a meeting on Thursday but was denied access.  A caravan led by **Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi** to meet **Khan** was stopped in Islamabad and resulted in a sit-in at Chungi No. 26.

recent_articles.title: How Kamala Harris sank: Democrats admit 2024 went horribly wrong but have no roadmap for 2028 - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Democratic Party** released a 192-page autopsy of its 2024 presidential campaign, authored by strategist Paul Rivera. The report criticizes the party's disconnect from working-class voters, weak economic messaging, cultural overreach, and organizational complacency.  It also suggests that Democrats failed to connect with Latino voters, men, rural Americans, and younger voters while failing to address issues like immigration, public safety, and inflation. However, the report notably avoids a sustained examination of President Biden's decision to seek re-election despite concerns about his age and stamina. The document was released despite criticism from **Democratic National Committee** chairman Ken Martin who acknowledged its shortcomings.  The party now faces internal divisions over how to address these issues and regain voter trust.

recent_articles.title: One Nation’s rapid national expansion in disarray as ‘significant risks’ force dissolution of new branches | One Nation | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **One Nation** has been forced to dissolve and re-establish its new branch network less than eight months after its ambitious rollout began due to internal inconsistencies.  The party's general manager, **Kelvin Morton**, issued a directive requiring all branches to comply with strict vetting processes, including non-disclosure agreements and media silence policies. This move has raised concerns about the party's commitment to free speech, as it attempts to control its grassroots movement ahead of the next election.  The party's headquarters intends to maintain tight control over branch operations and communications.

recent_articles.title: Pauline Hanson announces Norway-inspired gas policy as she decries 25% export tax as ‘economic vandalism’ | One Nation | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **One Nation** leader Pauline Hanson proposed a new policy to replace the petroleum resource rent tax (PRRT) with a royalty regime and acquire equity stakes in gas ventures.  Hanson’s proposal, which she described as “not socialist”, aims to increase returns for Australian taxpayers by co-owning new projects. The plan drew criticism from industry groups like the Minerals Council of Australia and opposition parties who argue it is not suitable for a mature industry. **James Paterson**, a Liberal frontbencher, called the policy "borrowed from Venezuela" while **Madeleine King**, the resources minister, expressed concern about government investment in an already established sector.

recent_articles.title: CM’s appeal to kids for votes: Plea in Madras High Court seeks an inquiry by Election Commission - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: DMK, AIADMK, Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, Election Commission of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A public interest litigation petition has been filed in the Madras High Court, seeking an inquiry by the **Election Commission of India (ECI)** into allegations of electoral malpractice during the 2026 Tamil Nadu Assembly elections. The petitioner, L. Vasuki, argues that **Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay**'s appeal to children to vote for his party, Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), constitutes "exploitation of minor children for electoral propaganda" and falls under the definition of corrupt practice.  The petition also cites a representation by the anti-corruption organization Arappor Iyakkam alleging that **DMK** and **AIADMK** members distributed cash to voters in certain constituencies. The court has sought responses from the **ECI** and **CEO** by May 29, 2026.

recent_articles.title: Dublin gangland figure brings extremist views to Irish mainstream on campaign trail | Ireland | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Gerry "the monk" Hutch**, a prominent gangland figure, is running as an independent candidate in the Dublin Central byelection.  His campaign has been fueled by xenophobic rhetoric and hostility towards immigrants, particularly Black immigrants and Muslims. While mainstream parties disavow racism, they have adopted tougher immigration policies. **Mary Lou McDonald** of Sinn Féin and **Micheal Martin**, the current taoiseach, have both condemned Hutch's comments on immigration. The election is being held amidst a backdrop of rising prices, housing shortages, and public discontent with the government's handling of these issues.

recent_articles.title: D.K. Shivakumar challenges BJP leaders to travel by public transport daily - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, Deputy Chief Minister of **Karnataka**, criticized **BJP** leaders for using public transport only for photoshoots in response to the Prime Minister's call for austerity measures. He challenged them to travel by public transport daily, questioning the sincerity of their actions.  He also addressed the Prime Minister's call to abstain from buying gold and expressed his commitment to visit Delhi when called upon by **Rahul Gandhi**, Leader of the Opposition.

recent_articles.title: T.N. Cabinet expansion LIVE: Congress set to join Tamil Nadu’s first coalition government in decades - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay** is set to expand his Cabinet with the oath of office for 23 new ministers scheduled for Thursday, May 21, 2026.  The ceremony will take place at **Lok Bhavan**. The Congress party, which won five seats in the alliance led by the **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, is joining the coalition government. **Thol. Thirumavalavan**, leader of the VCK, and the **IUML** have been invited to join the Council of Ministers.

recent_articles.title: Ponraj seeks anticipatory bail in two cases booked for derogatory speech against TVK women wing members - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **V. Ponraj**, a distinguished scientist and former advisor to the President, has filed two anticipatory bail petitions in the Madras High Court, fearing arrest by **Chennai** and **Cuddalore** police for alleged derogatory speech against women supporting **C. Joseph Vijay** and his party, **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**.  He claims the allegations are false and politically motivated, arguing that he is a senior scientist with no flight risk and willing to cooperate with any investigation. The petitions will be heard by Justice R. Sakthivel on Thursday (May 21, 2026).

recent_articles.title: Ponraj seeks anticipatory bail in two cases booked for derogatory speech against TVK women wing members - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **V. Ponraj**, a distinguished scientist and former advisor to the President, has filed two anticipatory bail petitions in the Madras High Court against arrest by **Chennai** and **Cuddalore** police for alleged derogatory speech against women supporting **C. Joseph Vijay** and his party, **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**.  He claims the allegations are false and politically motivated, asserting that he is a senior scientist with no intention of interfering with the investigation. The petitions will be heard by Justice R. Sakthivel on Thursday (May 21, 2026).

recent_articles.title: Chris Rabb win in Pennsylvania energises Democrats’ progressive flank | Donald Trump News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chris Rabb** won the Pennsylvania US House primary, securing a victory that bolsters Democrats' progressive flank.  The win signifies a shift in party dynamics as **Rabb**, who ran on a platform of bold working-class leadership and an end to the status quo, defeated his opponents, including State Senator Sharif Street and paediatric surgeon Ala Stanford. The race is seen as a sign of hope for progressives facing challenges in primary races, particularly those critical of Washington's support for Israel.  The outcome also reflects internal strife within the Democratic party following their 2024 election loss. **Rabb** will likely face little opposition in the general election and represents a potential boost to Democrats' progressive wing.

recent_articles.title: US police officers sue Trump over $1.8bn ‘anti-weaponisation’ fund | Donald Trump News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Two US police officers, Harry Dunn and Daniel Hodges, have filed a lawsuit against the **Trump** administration alleging that its $1.776 billion "anti-weaponisation" fund will be used to compensate January 6th rioters. The officers argue that the fund is a form of presidential corruption and will encourage further violence by rewarding those who attacked the US Capitol.  The lawsuit seeks to dissolve the fund, claiming it allows for taxpayer money to be disbursed to participants in the attack on January 6th, 2021.

recent_articles.title: Brexit may be back, but Britain needs to know what it wants | World news | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Wes Streeting**, a former health secretary and Labour party leadership candidate, recently made remarks suggesting Brexit was a "catastrophic mistake" and that the UK's future lies in the EU.  His comments reflect a deep divide within British politics regarding the impact of Brexit. While **Keir Starmer**, the current leader of the Labour party, has promised to reset relations with Europe, progress on closer ties remains limited. Despite economic damage caused by Brexit, there is growing support for closer UK-EU ties among both the public and European leaders. However, the UK's red lines regarding rejoining the EU or its single market remain a significant obstacle to any substantial rapprochement.

recent_articles.title: PM busy handing out candies in Italy amid economic storm at home, says Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** criticized the **Narendra Modi** government's economic policies, accusing it of prioritizing publicity over addressing rising inflation, unemployment, and weakening economic indicators.  **Kharge** highlighted the increase in average debt per Indian and wealth concentration among billionaires, while **Gandhi** criticized the Prime Minister's focus on foreign trips during a time of economic distress. Congress officials also pointed to the rupee's decline, falling foreign exchange reserves, and large investor outflows as evidence of government mismanagement.

recent_articles.title: Trump endorses Ken Paxton in Texas, gambling on a challenger with baggage in a crucial race
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump** endorsed **Ken Paxton**, Texas Attorney General, in his bid to unseat incumbent Senator John Cornyn. This move dismayed many Senate Republicans who view Paxton as a controversial figure with political baggage.  Trump's endorsement is part of a pattern of supporting challengers against Republican incumbents, and it could significantly impact the outcome of the upcoming primary election. The winner will face Democrat James Talarico in November's general election.
